page.overview:
Who is Bozai?

Bozai is a man who spends his days outside of in the . He's the giver of two , "" and "".

Bozai is 35 years old and loves jogging on sand. He believes that is a woman when he is wearing the and has a strong romantic affinity for him. Bozai behaves rudely to Link if he is not disguised as a woman, saying that he would only consider giving him his if he were a girl.

Link can first find Bozai sometimes running around the Gerudo Desert in front of Gerudo Town if the Rune has already been unlocked as it will be required for completing his quest. If he's spoken to while wearing the , Bozai will introduce himself to Link, making note that he is single and loves jogging on sand. Bozai then explains that while everyone has heard of , there is also a legend of an Eighth Heroine in the northern that has been wiped from history. Bozai promises to give Link his Sand Boots if he shows him a Picture of the Eighth Heroine.

Before he finishes speaking, Bozai lends Link his pair of for faster traversal through the northern Gerudo Highlands. This begins the Side Quest "The Eighth Heroine".
